Hi Marta — welcome, and glad the demo was useful.

Short answer: we can sometimes approve an invoice-only path for time-limited trials, but we need a lightweight controls package and formal approval from Procurement/Finance. To move quickly, please: 1) confirm anticipated spend (you listed ~$2.7k), 2) confirm billing contact, and 3) confirm if you will accept a short written exception with a 90-day maximum and audit rights.

Looping in Marissa (CS/sales onboarding) and Laura (Finance) to vet the ask and start the exception process.

Proposed next steps:
- Marta: confirm the three items above and re-send the onboarding form if any fields are missing
- Marissa: summarize the commercial terms we can accept for a pilot exception
- Laura / Procurement: advise approval criteria and any required docs (insurance, SOC2 evidence, etc.)

If Procurement prefers, we can propose a capped SOW and a short DocuSign exception instead of a PO.

Best,

Thanks David. Marta — quick note from the sales/onboarding side:

- We support a one-off invoice-only onboarding for pilot customers when spend is low and timeboxed.
- Typical guardrails: spend cap <= $5,000; trial length <= 90 days; single invoice at trial end; minimum acceptance of our standard T&Cs or a short SOW.

I've attached a suggested canary_terms.docx with the language we've used on other pilots (liability cap, data usage, termination). If BlueBridge signs that and provides the onboarding form + risk matrix, we can escalate for a short exception.

Attachments: canary_terms.docx

Next: Laura, can you confirm any finance docs you need to approve under $5k? If Procurement needs to run a quick check, please tag them.

—Marissa

Subject: Re: BlueBridge trial onboarding — PO requirement?

Hi team,

Finance view and required controls for an invoice-only pilot:
1) Spend cap confirmation and authorizing sig on the onboarding form (we need a number)
2) BlueBridge must accept a temporary exception letter (we prepare) with the following conditions:
   - 90-day maximum trial window
   - Single invoice at trial end or prepayment option
   - Audit access to usage logs for a 12-month period
3) Required evidence: current W-9, proof of insurance (if applicable), and SOC2 type II report (if available).
4) For spend <= $3k we can approve at Finance level; for $3k-$5k Procurement sign-off is required; >$5k requires standard PO and contract routing.

Given Marta's stated ~$2.7k, Finance can provisionally approve this provided the onboarding form is complete and the exception letter is signed.

Priyom / Karthik, please confirm procurement process for the $3k-$5k threshold and whether a short DocuSign SOW is acceptable instead of a PO for this category.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — Procurement here. Based on the details provided:

- We approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for BlueBridge capped at $3,000 (per Finance guidance).
- Conditions: onboarding form completed with billing contact; signed exception letter (Procurement will draft); SOC2 or AICPA evidence preferred but not blocking for this cap; single invoice required and flagged in our AP system.
- For any spend drift toward $3k-$5k, Procurement must be notified immediately and will require an internal approval.

Next steps I will take today:
1) Draft the exception letter and share DocuSign link for BlueBridge signature: https://docusign.com/temporary-sow/BB-TRIAL-2028-03
2) Add the vendor to our onboarding queue with a temporary invoice-only tag
3) Confirm AP routing instructions so invoices are paid Net 30

Marta — if you can confirm billing contact and re-upload the onboarding form with signature, I’ll send the exception doc for signature and we can get you live for the trial.

Thanks,
